purpose: A bounded cooperative combat and exploration arena whose portals, hazards, hidden route, and recovery cues remain readable from angled and top-down play cameras.
runtimeSurface: Three.js WebGL browser client driven by authoritative Socket.IO snapshots at a 30 Hz server simulation rate.

hero.role: Navigation objective and transition affordance after encounter completion.

exceptions: The secret west chamber and paired Deepwood root clusters deliberately break bilateral symmetry to support exploration.

circulation.description: A central combat lane connects the north and south portal frames. Side circulation reaches pillars, the concealed west chamber, and non-colliding root dressing without blocking the portal centerline.
